# Switch NX2 - read when the Lichii GUI starts.
# One NAME=VALUE per line. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# A variable already set in the environment wins over this file.
# Between files, the user copy (%APPDATA%\eden\nx2_switches.txt, or
# $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/eden/nx2_switches.txt) wins over this one, so editing this file is never
# needed: copy the lines you want into your own and restart.
#
# Restart the emulator after editing.

# --- Performance tuning defaults for Switch 2 ---
# Offload GPU method/macro execution to the back thread (SPLIT=2 delivers up to +54% FPS alone).
EDEN_NX2_SPLIT=2

# Batch GPU fence syncpoints to reduce host driver overhead and smooth frametimes.
EDEN_NX2_FENCE_BATCH=1

# Leave buffer downloads disabled on Switch 2 (default): forcing downloads (=1) copies back
# 90-220 MB/s of buffers CPU never touches, causing heavy mutex contention and dropping FPS by ~38-63%.
#EDEN_NX2_BUFFER_DOWNLOADS=1

# Paces frame submission 2 frames ahead. Reduces frametime spikes, but adds ~1-2 frames of input latency.
# Enable only if frame pacing stability is preferred over responsive controls.
#EDEN_NX2_FRAMES_AHEAD=2

# --- Workarounds / Debug ---
# Terrain/indirect drawing fix for Donkey Kong Bananza: enabled by default. Set to 0 only to leave to GPU.
#EDEN_NX2_RESETFIX=0

# Drop reactive-flushing read traps on Switch 2 programs (opt-in; can reduce FPS from 29 to 24 in MKW).
#EDEN_NX2_NO_REACTIVE=1

#EDEN_NX2_MME_JIT=0
#EDEN_NX2_PBFLUSH=0
#EDEN_NX2_SKIP_SAME=0
#EDEN_NX2_INLINE_DEFER=0
#EDEN_NX2_SPLIT_SKIP=1
#EDEN_NX2_AUTO_STUB=1
#EDEN_NX2_KEEP_ASTC=1

# --- chuppatricky-amd-testbuild (Ocarina of Time on AMD) ---
# Ocarina of Time fog: reduced, on, off or original. Change the value below, or put the line in your own
# %APPDATA%\eden\nx2_switches.txt (it wins over this file) and restart.
#   reduced: the outdoor haze thinned to 1/4 and the final exposure lowered to 0.65 (closer to the
#            console; the default here)
#   on:      the game's full fog as this emulator draws it (thicker than on the console),
#            exposure 0.65
#   off:     no fog at all, exposure 0.65
#   original: no changes at all: full fog and the emulator's brighter image
# Older builds' EDEN_NX2_OOT_VISUAL_WORKAROUND=0 now means "original".
EDEN_NX2_OOT_FOG=reduced

# Builds every cached shader pipeline at boot instead of when first needed. Ocarina's cache is a few
# hundred pipelines, so boot takes a little longer and areas you've visited before stop stuttering.
# To turn it off: EDEN_NX2_PRELOAD_ALL_PIPELINES=0
EDEN_NX2_PRELOAD_ALL_PIPELINES=1

# Diagnostic: logs each shader compile as it starts and finishes, so a log from a PC that freezes
# shows the shader the graphics driver hangs on. Adds a few hundred lines to the log.
EDEN_NX2_LOG_PIPELINE_COMPILES=1

# Radeon RX 5000/6000 on Windows (AMD driver older than 2.0.388): the largest compute shaders are
# built without driver optimizations, since that driver froze compiling one of them at the title
# screen. Automatic; EDEN_NX2_AMD_SAFE_COMPILE=0 turns it off, =1 forces it on any AMD driver.
# EDEN_NX2_AMD_SAFE_COMPILE_MIN_KIB=0 applies it to every compute shader if the freeze remains.

# Radeon on Windows: if the game closes by itself with no error around the Deku Tree (the log just
# stops), remove the "# " in front of the next line. Experimental: graphics shaders are then built
# without driver optimizations too, which may cost some speed.
# EDEN_NX2_AMD_SAFE_COMPILE_GRAPHICS=1

# "Device loss occurred" soon after gameplay starts (RX 9070 XT, 9060 XT, 7800 XT): v13 fixes the
# shader loop that hung the GPU. If it still happens, first remove the "# " in front of the next
# line and send the log: it records which shaders the GPU was running when it hung.
# EDEN_NX2_GPU_BREADCRUMBS=1
# Last resort: remove the "# " in front of the next line. It skips the six fog, lighting and
# vegetation compute shaders the Max Resolution mode added: less fog, light and grass.
# EDEN_NX2_REJECT_HASH=0051f3226c2ac35e,7ca59d64e659a9e1,9a24d120a5fa2a93,affbb36232fcda8f,e311d97dbe057ad3,394cb954427f6336
